name: CMF Headphones
author: Miguel Rincon
description: Battery, noise mode and LDAC for a CMF Headphone Pro, driven by the cmfctl CLI over Bluetooth RFCOMM.

barWidget.description: Shows battery and noise mode; switches all six noise modes and LDAC without the phone app.

schema.label: Refresh interval while the panel is closed (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask the headphones for battery and noise mode while the popup is shut. Each check opens a Bluetooth link, so a long interval costs less power.

schema.label: Refresh interval while the panel is open (seconds)
schema.description: How often to refresh while the popup is open, so a change made elsewhere shows up quickly.
